page.overview:
What is Eileen Snape?

Eileen Snape (née Prince) (born c. 1930) was a witch, wife to the Muggle Tobias Snape and mother to Severus Snape.

Eileen was born into the wizarding Prince family in Great Britain, likely around 1930.

She likely began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry around 1941. While at school, Eileen was captain of the school Gobstones team during her fifth year. She was concurrently the President of the Hogwarts Gobstone Club.

After graduating, Eileen met the Muggle Tobias Snape and married him.
